UC-913.en: 1 more is only in {service}. Reading it downloads it to this computer.
UC-913.by: online words (provisional; Rohan's review page, item 52)
UC-913.note: The new conversation's clause for one paper only in a named sync service (iCloud Drive, OneDrive and so on), after U6-07's line. Replaces WA-07 (retired), which said nothing of whether reading the paper downloads it; Claude and ChatGPT download such a paper when asked, and this says Clauseo's reads do too. With no named service the clause stays WA-11

UC-914.note: The same clause for several papers only in a named sync service, after U6-05's line. Replaces WA-05 (retired). With no named service the clause stays WA-10

UC-915.en: Not on this computer, so Clauseo keeps no versions of it yet. Reading it in a conversation downloads it.
UC-915.by: online words (provisional; Rohan's review page, item 52)
UC-915.note: The tip of a dimmed tile for a file only online, its first two sentences. Replaces WA-02 and WA-09 (both retired): "Not on this computer, so Clauseo doesn't open it or save new versions of it." and "Download it to this computer to change that." On OneDrive, the keep-on-this-device sentence (WA-03 on Windows, WA-06 on the Mac) follows it
